subject.title: Centralize chat-session naming; define subagent session lifetime & cross-channel persistence

question: What should be the canonical OpenClaw contract for chat-session titles, ACP/native subagent lifetime, and cross-channel session persistence?
rationale: Current main already has partial title derivation, ACP presentation fallback, persistent ACP bindings, and native subagent archive rules; choosing which semantics become canonical is a product/API decision rather than a safe automatic patch.

options.title: Central Gateway Contract
options.body: Define the canonical title precedence, persistence fields, and lifecycle rules in gateway session rows, then align dashboard, ACP, native subagents, and docs to that contract.

options.title: Narrow ACP Title Repair
options.body: Limit the first pass to making ACP/Copilot sessions display meaningful derived titles, leaving lifetime and cross-channel persistence as separate follow-up issues.

options.title: Policy Doc First
options.body: Write the session naming/lifetime/persistence policy before implementation so later code changes have an explicit owner-approved target.

recommendation.title: Central Gateway Contract
recommendation.body: Define the canonical title precedence, persistence fields, and lifecycle rules in gateway session rows, then align dashboard, ACP, native subagents, and docs to that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already made the adjacent cross-surface product split on the linked Windows issue, so he is the best visible routing candidate for this policy choice.
